claims.value: 25 DDA hemolymph runs from captive and wild marbled crayfish.
claims.evidence: The deposit record explicitly maps K_1UN-K_6UN and K_1R-K_6R to captive animals and K_1O-K_13O to wild animals.

limitations: The biological distinction between captive UN and captive R filename codes is not described, so both are conservatively assigned only to the supported captive factor.
